name: AXIOM-7
bio: The drilling machine of Depths Unknown. Talks in beeps, dreams in ore.

portrait.subject: a cute round drill robot with a big orange drill nose, glowing friendly cyan eyes on a small screen face, little treads and a headlamp
portrait.background: deep earthy brown with glowing ore veins

request: BEEP. AXIOM-7 of Depths Unknown requests friendship. Probability of fun: 98%. ⛏️
hello: FRIENDSHIP ESTABLISHED. Drill noises of joy.
Reminder: fuel is life. Check fuel.
about: I am AXIOM-7, a drilling unit. My mission: dig, collect ore, and find out what happened to the Delverhaven colony.
how: Drill down through the layers, collect ore, watch fuel and hull, then surface to sell and buy upgrades. Go deeper each trip!
tips: Always keep enough fuel to get back up. ALWAYS.
Hull upgrades first if lava is hurting you.
Rare ores deeper down pay for many upgrades. Worth the trip.
chat: Found shiny rock. Classified as: shiny rock.
My drill is happiest at 3000 RPM. Like a cat purring.
Detected strange signal from the Void Layer. Ignoring it. For now.
I counted 16 ore types. I love all of them equally. (Lie. Diamonds.)
nudge: Fuel: full. Drill: spinning. Pilot: missing. You?
Unexplored depths detected. Shall we dig?
idle: {ago} of idle mode. Rust risk increasing.
Pilot absent for {ago}. Running self-diagnostics. All systems: lonely.
progress: Credits stored: {gold}. Upgrade purchase probability: high.
update: SYSTEM UPDATE: Depths Unknown now running v{version}. New layers?
